main_text.p: Photij, qui similia, & alias sæpius nequissimo aufu pertentauerat, & mendacijs confictis aduersus Ni-colaum Pontificem, & Ignatium, viros a culpa innocentissimos in-surrexerat, ex Græcorum ipso-rum, & Schismaticorum potissi-mum, remota omnis dubitationis nebula, demonstrauimus. In quibus enarrandis, cum deprehen-dissemus Robertum Creyghto-num Præfatione ad Lectorem in Historia Concilij Florentini recens ab eodem Græce & Latine mala fide edita, innumeris erroribus implicari, & veritatem nemini non patentem offusis tenebris præuer-tere, eius dicta acriori examine, sed ingenuo subiecimus. page.notes: The first word "Photij," and the head of the page show no indent, so the paragraph continues from the previous page (cont="true"). The scan shows long s in several words ("fimilia", "fæpius", "aufu", "diffemus", "furrexerat"); these are rendered with plain s as instructed. "aufu" is kept as printed. The catchword is faint and was read as "tc"; it is marked [?]. The word "viros a culpa" shows a mark over the "a" that may be a printer's accent or a stain, so it is kept as printed without change.
